event.name: YSE Pie Day
event.descriptionText:
Open to members of the Yale School of the Environment Community.

All YSE faculty, staff, and students are invited to our annual Pie Day to celebrate the fall season. Please join us in Kroon for a slice of pie and other delicious seasonal treats!
